title: Component
description: An atomic building block an essay is assembled from — a paragraph-or-smaller unit with one job (a hook, a thesis, a counterargument). Essay types compose components; they don't redefine them.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. Essay types reference components by this id — renaming it is a breaking change for every type that refs it.

purpose.description: The problem this component solves for the reader, stated crux-first — why it needs to exist, not just what it contains.

placement.description: Where in the essay this component typically lands.

example.description: One concrete instance a reader can pattern-match against.

notes.description: Caveats or variants worth knowing (e.g. how this component's job shifts between essay types).
